one_liner: Cloud work management platform for sheets, projects, and workflows
blocker: API access requires a paid plan (Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management); no free-tier API access is documented.

evidence.claim: The API uses OAuth 2.0 with an access token sent in the Authorization header; docs also refer to access tokens as API keys.
evidence.quote: The Smartsheet API utilizes OAuth 2.0 for authentication and authorization. An Authorization HTTP header containing an access token is required to authenticate

evidence.claim: API access is restricted to paid plans.
evidence.quote: Business, Enterprise, or Advanced Work Management

evidence.claim: The REST API covers many resource types (Sheets, Cells, Folders, Users, Reports, Dashboards), indicating broad surface area.
evidence.quote: The Smartsheet API enables you to programmatically access and manage your organization's Smartsheet resources.

evidence.claim: Smartsheet officially ships an MCP server documented on its own developer site.
evidence.quote: Connect Smartsheet to AI clients like Claude, Cursor, and Codex, and use 30+ tools to manage your sheets, rows, columns, and more

evidence.claim: Users on a qualifying plan can self-serve generate a personal API access token from account settings.
evidence.quote: Navigate to the API Access tab and select Generate

notes: Official MCP server is generally available (vendor blog: 'Smartsheet MCP Server now generally available') and routes through the REST API with 30+ tools. Regional base URLs exist: api.smartsheet.com/2.0, api.smartsheetgov.com/2.0 (Gov), api.smartsheet.eu/2.0, api.smartsheet.au/2.0. Official SDKs for JavaScript/Node, Python, Java, and C#. Use of the API is governed by a Developer Agreement. Personal access tokens double as bearer tokens in the Authorization header, so simple integrations can skip the OAuth flow.
